description: The length-floor routes into an element read carry their own obligations. A guard over a body local is declaration-decided and keeps the body live, so an arm that bounds the index on one side only leaves the read optional. A store the analysis reaches revokes every proof measured against the sequence border. The border read xs[#xs] is discharged by a proven non-empty length and by nothing weaker, and a two-sided index bound - by container length or by a constant within the proven floor - discharges the read.
